what: The Stop button does nothing: the status stays as it was.
Clicking the blue swatch selects green: the selection ring lands on the wrong swatch.
Dropping the Note card puts it one column to the right of where it was dropped.
The Volume slider stops at 60: dragging to the end of the track leaves the knob short of it.
The Sound switch does nothing when clicked.
Start sets the status text to "Status: plying" (a wrong word, but the screen does change).
